body:
Founder real-time: 'also a parena based busybox to go with it.' Updated build-pi-image-rootless.sh step 3b to cross-compile PARENA's newly-added wc/head/yes.prn (commit 60256bb) and stage all 10 applet symlinks (up from 5) in /usr/local/parena-coreutils/. Live-verified: full build script re-run end to end, all 10 applets confirmed executing correctly under qemu-aarch64-static against the real staged rootfs. Commit 6788ad1.

⚓ ☃
title: Pi image: stage expanded parenabusybox applet set (wc/head/yes/cat/sleep/env)
